answer: The raven test I would run is Commercial driver medical card with transport authority attestation: a medical card renewed every two years, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the copper is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the nebula of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
